title: ZPA policy completeness: every ZPA policy type, AppProtection and the infrastructure behind the diagnostics
standards: WSTG ATHZ-02, ATHZ-03, CONF-01, CONF-05, ERRH-01, INFO-05, INPV-12

checks.what: redirection, credential, capabilities and browser protection (clientless) policies read with list_rules; policy_group* not read
servers, business continuity (one call, no paging), Private Cloud sites, groups and controllers, Branch and Cloud Connector groups and connectors read with list methods only
business continuity SAML private keys, certificates and metadata, and connector fingerprints never kept; snapshot scrub masks them
web segments with no INSPECT rule, monitor-only profiles, unattached custom controls
client forwarding BYPASS deciding for a sensitive segment (high unconditional, medium conditional, clean under an earlier Intercept)
clipboard copy and uninspected file transfer, unrecorded PRA sessions, credentials with no user condition
Browser Access allowed with no isolation (high when sensitive), no browser protection MONITOR rule
a list that fails to read leaves its templates not assessed; a 404 is N/A (not licensed) in the assessment
new reads only under the ZPA Scope key; ZPA not ticked is refused before sign-in; snapshot plan adds the lists under ZPA only
every new read is in the sample tenant and the snapshot capture; no network in tests
the Path analyzer and Device posture read only what they use (extended=False): no extra ZPA call per analysis

findings.title: Only five of the SDK's ZPA policy types were read: redirection, privileged credential and capabilities, and browser protection policies were never assessed
findings.fix: zpa_reader reads every policy type the SDK's PolicySetControllerAPI.POLICY_MAP lists except the portal, VPN and SIEM policies; ten templates and six assessment checks judge them.

findings.title: A server group listing its servers only through the application server list was called empty (ZPA-SV-01) and served by 0 servers in a diagnosis
findings.fix: Servers are counted from the group, else from the application server list (each server names its groups).

findings.title: The policy-group model (policy_group, policy_group_rule, policy_group_set) is not read
findings.fix: Left out on purpose until the model is documented; the reader's docstring and a test say so.
